doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

chapter: Early career: New Orleans to Tulsa
title: Travels abroad and playing with Moten and George E. Lee
summary: He says he never went to Yucatan but travelled to China, the Philippines, Canada and Mexico, and briefly played with Bennie Moten and George E. Lee in Kansas City.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I didn't go to Yucatan, Mexico with nobody. Oh, yeah. I went to China and I went to the Philippines Islands and I've been to Shanghai. And I've been all over Canada, you know, Mexico for them. Oh, you're traveling a lot. And I played with another band. I played a while with Benny Moten.
Oh, Benny Moten, out of Kansas City?
Yeah, Kansas City. Yeah. George Lee Boat, I played that. And Julia Lee? Till 1925. Oh, that early.
